name: joule-editor
description: Joule Code — Always-on agents. An agentic coding session in a side panel, driven by the joule daemon on your own machine.

commands.title: Joule: Open the session in an editor tab
Joule: Attach to this workspace's session

joule.path.description: Path to the joule binary. The daemon is started and stopped through it, so it must be the same install a terminal would use.

joule.openInEditorTab.description: Open the session in an editor tab beside your code when the window opens. It takes no focus from the file you opened the window on, and the activity bar icon stays where it is either way, so a tab you close stays closed until the icon, the title bar button or the command opens it again. Turn this off to leave the editor area to your files and work from the activity bar.

joule.attachOnStartup.description: Attach to this workspace's daemon as soon as the window opens. Off by default: attaching can join a session someone is already driving from a terminal, so it is an explicit action.

joule.resumeOnStart.description: When this window is the one that starts the daemon, resume the workspace's previous session instead of beginning a new one.
